QuestInfo.name: A Gift of Love
QuestInfo.1: #p9310538# asks you to buy an #i4034655:# #t4034655# for #p9310547#.\r\nThe #t4034655# can be purchased from #p9310554#, the Black Market Merchant, but only between 06:00 PM and 02:00 AM, when the lights go out. His wares change daily. Keep visiting until you find #t4034655#.
QuestInfo.2: You bought the #t4034655# from the Yu Garden Black Market Merchant and delivered it to #p9310538#. The Black Market Merchant sells many special and rare items that other merchants don't sell.

default.0: You haven't purchased the #t4310177# yet? The Black Market Merchant visits Yu Garden from 06:00 PM to 02:00 AM Pacific every night.
